response.overview: Saira has grown up stealing from strangers alongside her uncle Suresh, a former photographer who now snaps tourists while she lifts their wallets. But when an old film camera falls into her hands, the city she has only ever worked begins to reveal a quiet beauty, and a different way of seeing her own life.
response.tagline: When a young pickpocket discovers an abandoned film camera during a routine theft, a simple errand through Chandigarh becomes a journey that awakens her love for photography and offers a glimpse of a life beyond survival.
response.title: Pic Pocket
